segments.normalizedSource: ```swift // UTF-32 representation of "✨Unicode✨" let codeUnits: [UTF32.CodeUnit] = [10024, 85, 110, 105, 99, 111, 100, 101, 10024] var codeUnitIterator = codeUnits.makeIterator() var scalars: [Unicode.Scalar] = [] var utf32Decoder = UTF32() Decode: while true { switch utf32Decoder.decode(&codeUnitIterator) { case .scalarValue(let v): scalars.append(v) case .emptyInput: break Decode case .error: print("Decoding error") break Decode } } print(scalars) // Prints "["\u{2728}", "U", "n", "i", "c", "o", "d", "e", "\u{2728}"]" ```
